verses.en: And it came to pass afterward, that he went throughout every city and village, preaching and shewing the glad tidings of the kingdom of God: and the twelve were with him,
verses.sm: Mulimuli ane ua faataamilo o ia i aai ma faoa aai, ua tala‘i ma folafola le tala lelei o le malo o le Atua; ua faatasi foi ma ia le toasefulu ma le toalua,

verses.en: And certain women, which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities, Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven devils,
verses.sm: atoa ma nisi fafine sa i ai agaga leaga ma ma‘i, a ua faamaloloina; o Maria ua ta‘ua o le Makatala, na ō i fafo ia te ia temoni e toafitu,

verses.en: And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod's steward, and Susanna, and many others, which ministered unto him of their substance.
verses.sm: ma Ioana le avā a Kusa le auauna pule lea a Herota, ma Susana; atoa ma isi fafine e toatele, e na auauna atu ia te ia i a latou mea.

verses.en: And when much people were gathered together, and were come to him out of every city, he spake by a parable:
verses.sm: Ua faapotopotoina mai le motu o tagata e toatele, ua o mai ia te ia mai lea aai ma lea aai, ona fetalai atu lea o ia le faataoto.

verses.en: A sower went out to sow his seed: and as he sowed, some fell by the way side; and it was trodden down, and the fowls of the air devoured it.
verses.sm: Ua alu atu le tagata lulu saito e lulu ai ana saito; ua ia lulu saito, ua paū ai isi i le auala; ona solia lea, ua ‘aina foi e manu felelei.

verses.en: And some fell upon a rock; and as soon as it was sprung up, it withered away, because it lacked moisture.
verses.sm: Ua paū isi i le mea papa; ua tupu, ona magumagu ai lea, auā e le su.

verses.en: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprang up with it, and choked it.
verses.sm: A ua paū isi i le vao tuitui; ua tutupu faatasi ia ma le vao tuitui, ona fetinaiina ai lea.

verses.en: And other fell on good ground, and sprang up, and bare fruit an hundredfold. And when he had said these things, he cried, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.sm: Ua paū foi isi i le eleele lelei; ua tupu, ua fua mai taiselau i fua. Ua fetalai atu ia i nei mea, ona alaga atu lea, O le ua i ai taliga e faalogo ai, ina faalogo mai ia o ia.

verses.en: And his disciples asked him, saying, What might this parable be?
verses.sm: A ua fesili mai ona soo ia te ia, ua faapea mai, Se a ea le faataoto nei?

verses.en: And he said, Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God: but to others in parables; that seeing they might not see, and hearing they might not understand.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu lea o ia, Ua foaiina atu ia te outou ina ia outou iloa mea lilo a le malo o le Atua; a ua fai atu i nisi i faataoto; ina ia latou le vaai i lo latou vaai, ina ia le lagona foi i lo latou faalogo.

verses.en: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.
verses.sm: O le faataoto lenei, O le saito, o le afioga lea a le Atua.

verses.en: Those by the way side are they that hear; then cometh the devil, and taketh away the word out of their hearts, lest they should believe and be saved.
verses.sm: O e i le auala, o e faalogo ia; ona alu ane ai lea o le tiapolo, ma aveeseina le upu nai o latou loto, ne‘i faatuatua ma faaolaina i latou.

verses.en: They on the rock are they, which, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, which for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away.
verses.sm: O e i le mea papa, o i latou ia, pe a faalogo i le upu, ua talia ma le fiafia; a e leai ni o latou aa, ua faaletumau lo latou faatuatua, ua oo atu i aso e faaosoosoina ai, ona o ese ai lea.

verses.en: And that which fell among thorns are they, which, when they have heard, go forth, and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life, and bring no fruit to perfection.
verses.sm: O le mea na paū i le vao tuitui, o i latou ia e ua faalogo, ua o atu ai, ona fetinaiina ai lea i mea e popole ai, ma oloa, ma mea faafiafia o le olaga nei, ona le oo lea ina matua o latou fua.

verses.en: But that on the good ground are they, which in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, keep it, and bring forth fruit with patience.
verses.sm: Peitai o le mea na i le eleele lelei, o i latou ia e ua faalogo i le upu, ma tausi i ai i le loto ua faamaoni ma le lelei, ona fua mai ai lea ma le onosai.

verses.en: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, covereth it with a vessel, or putteth it under a bed; but setteth it on a candlestick, that they which enter in may see the light.
verses.sm: E leai se tagata na te tŭtŭ se lamepa, ma ufiufi ai i le tanoa, pe tuu i lalo o le moega; a e tuu i luga o le tuugālamepa, ina ia iloa atu le malamalama e i latou ua ulufale mai.

verses.en: For nothing is secret, that shall not be made manifest; neither any thing hid, that shall not be known and come abroad.
verses.sm: Auā e leai se mea lilo e le faaalia; e leai foi se mea natia e le faailoa, a e iu ina faaalia.

verses.en: Take heed therefore how ye hear: for whosoever hath, to him shall be given; and whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he seemeth to have.
verses.sm: O lenei, ia outou, pe faapefea lo outou faalogo; auā o se ua i ai mea, e foaiina mai ia te ia; a o se ua le i ai mea, e aveeseina ia te ia o mea ua peiseai ua ia te ia.

verses.en: Then came to him his mother and his brethren, and could not come at him for the press.
verses.sm: Ua o mai ia te ia lona tinā ma ona uso, a ua le masao mai ia te ia ona o le motu o tagata.

verses.en: And it was told him by certain which said, Thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to see thee.
verses.sm: Ua fai mai nisi ia te ia, ua faapea mai, Ua tutū lou tinā ma ou uso i fafo, ua fia feiloai ma oe.

verses.en: And he answered and said unto them, My mother and my brethren are these which hear the word of God, and do it.
verses.sm: Ua tali atu ia, ua faapea atu ia te i latou, O e faalogo i le afioga a le Atua, ma latou faia, o lo‘u tinā ma o‘u uso lava ia.

verses.en: Now it came to pass on a certain day, that he went into a ship with his disciples: and he said unto them, Let us go over unto the other side of the lake. And they launched forth.
verses.sm: Ua maliu ae ia ma ona soo i le tasi aso i le vaa; ua fetalai atu foi o ia ia te i latou, Tatou o ia i le tasi itu vai, ona latou tuuvaa atu lea.

verses.en: But as they sailed he fell asleep: and there came down a storm of wind on the lake; and they were filled with water, and were in jeopardy.
verses.sm: Ua alu lo latou vaa, a e tofa o ia, ona to ifo lea o le afā i le vai, ua osofia lo latou vaa, ua tāli goto.

verses.en: And they came to him, and awoke him, saying, Master, master, we perish. Then he arose, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water: and they ceased, and there was a calm.
verses.sm: Ona latou o ane lea ua fafagu ia te ia, ua faapea mai, Le Alii e, le Alii e, o le a matou fano. Ona tu lea o ia, ua vavao i le matagi ma peau o le vai; ona mavae ai lea, ua malū.

verses.en: And he said unto them, Where is your faith? And they being afraid wondered, saying one to another, What manner of man is this! for he commandeth even the winds and water, and they obey him.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu ia ia te i latou, O ifea ea lo outou faatuatua? Ua matatau lava i latou ma ofo; ua fetautalatala‘i i latou, O ai ea lenei? auā ua fetalai o ia i le matagi ma le vai, ona usiusitai ai lea ia te ia.

verses.en: And they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is over against Galilee.
verses.sm: Ua latou oo atu i le laueleele o Katara, o le itu vai lea ua feagai ma Kalilaia.

verses.en: And when he went forth to land, there met him out of the city a certain man, which had devils long time, and ware no clothes, neither abode in any house, but in the tombs.
verses.sm: Ua maliu ae ia i uta, ona fetaiai lea ma ia o le tasi tagata mai le aai ua leva ona ia te ia o temoni, ua le ofu o ia, ua le nofo foi i se fale, a o tuugamau.

verses.en: When he saw Jesus, he cried out, and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God most high? I beseech thee, torment me not.
verses.sm: Ua iloa mai e ia o Iesu, ona alaga mai lea o ia, ma faapaū mai i ona luma, ua fai mai ia te ia ma le leo tele, Se a lau na ia te au nei, Iesu e, o oe na le Alo o le Atua silisili ese? ou te aioi atu ia te oe, aua e te faatiga mai ia te au.

verses.en: (For he had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For oftentimes it had caught him: and he was kept bound with chains and in fetters; and he brake the bands, and was driven of the devil into the wilderness.)
verses.sm: Auā na fetalai o ia i le agaga leaga e alu i fafo i le tagata. Auā na atu lasi ona pue ia te ia; ua fusifusia o ia i maea uamea, ma mea e faamau a‘i vae ua leoleoina ai o ia, a ua motumotusia maea ia te ia, ona avea ai lea o ia e le temoni i le vao.)

verses.en: And Jesus asked him, saying, What is thy name? And he said, Legion: because many devils were entered into him.
verses.sm: Ua fesili atu Iesu ia te ia, ua faapea atu, O ai ea lou igoa? Ua fai mai o ia, O Lekeono; auā ua uluitino ia te ia temoni e toatele.

verses.en: And they besought him that he would not command them to go out into the deep.
verses.sm: Ua latou aioi mai ia te ia, aua le fetalai o ia ia te i latou e o i le fafā.

verses.en: And there was there an herd of many swine feeding on the mountain: and they besought him that he would suffer them to enter into them. And he suffered them.
verses.sm: Sa i ai le lafu puaa e tele, sa tataa i le mauga; ua latou faanoi mai ia te ia ia tuu atu latou te uluitino i ai. Ona tuu atu ai lea ia te i latou.

verses.en: Then went the devils out of the man, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake, and were choked.
verses.sm: Ona o lea o temoni i fafo nai le tagata, a ua uluitino i puaa; ona feosofi ifo lea o le lafu i le tofē i le vai, ua malelemo ai.

verses.en: When they that fed them saw what was done, they fled, and went and told it in the city and in the country.
verses.sm: Ua iloa ē sa faga puaa i le mea ua faia, ona sosola ai lea, ua o atu ua tala atu i le aai ma ona faoa aai.

verses.en: Then they went out to see what was done; and came to Jesus, and found the man, out of whom the devils were departed, sitting at the feet of Jesus, clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.
verses.sm: Ona latou o mai lea e matamata i le mea ua faia; ua o mai ia Iesu, ua latou iloa atu le tagata ua o i fafo ia te ia temoni, o loo nofo o ia i vae o Iesu; ua ofu ia, ma ua atamai; ona latou matatau ai lea.

verses.en: They also which saw it told them by what means he that was possessed of the devils was healed.
verses.sm: O e na iloa ua latou tala atu ia te i latou le mea na malolo ai le tagata sa uluitinoina.

verses.en: Then the whole multitude of the country of the Gadarenes round about besought him to depart from them; for they were taken with great fear: and he went up into the ship, and returned back again.
verses.sm: Ona aioi mai lea ia te ia o le nuu uma o Katara, ina ia maliu ese o ia ia te i latou; auā ua oo ia te i latou le mata‘u tele; ona maliu ae lea o ia i le vaa, ua toe foi atu.

verses.en: Now the man out of whom the devils were departed besought him that he might be with him: but Jesus sent him away, saying,
verses.sm: Ua aioi mai ia te ia le tagata ua o i fafo ia te ia temoni, la te faatasi ma ia; a ua auina atu ia e Iesu, ua faapea atu,

verses.en: Return to thine own house, and shew how great things God hath done unto thee. And he went his way, and published throughout the whole city how great things Jesus had done unto him.
verses.sm: Ina foi atu ia oe i lou aiga, ma ia faamatala atu i mea tetele ua faia e le Atua ia te oe. Ona alu ai lea o ia, ua tala‘i i le aai uma i mea tetele na faia e Iesu ia te ia.

verses.en: And it came to pass, that, when Jesus was returned, the people gladly received him: for they were all waiting for him.
verses.sm: Ua toe foi atu Iesu, ona talia ai lea o ia e le motu o tagata; auā sa faatali mai i latou uma ia te ia.

verses.en: And, behold, there came a man named Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue: and he fell down at Jesus' feet, and besought him that he would come into his house:
verses.sm: Faauta foi, ua sau le tagata e igoa ia Iairo, o ia foi le tasi e pule i le sunako; ua faapaū ia i vae o Iesu, ma faatoga mai ia te ia ia maliu atu o ia i lona fale;

verses.en: For he had one only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she lay a dying. But as he went the people thronged him.
verses.sm: auā o lona afafine e toatasi, po ua sefulu ma le lua ona tausaga, o le a oti ia. Ua maliu atu ia, a ua fetaomi mai ia te ia le motu o tagata.

verses.en: And a woman having an issue of blood twelve years, which had spent all her living upon physicians, neither could be healed of any,
verses.sm: O le fafine sa ia te ia le puna toto i tausaga e sefulu ma le lua, ua uma atu ana mea i fomai, a ua le mafai ona malolo i se tasi,

verses.en: Came behind him, and touched the border of his garment: and immediately her issue of blood stanched.
verses.sm: ua alu ane ia i ona tua, ma pa‘i ane i le tuupao o lona ofu; ona utu loa lea o lona puna toto.

verses.en: And Jesus said, Who touched me? When all denied, Peter and they that were with him said, Master, the multitude throng thee and press thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?
verses.sm: Ona fetalai ane lea o Iesu, O ai ea na na pa‘i mai ia te au? Ua faafiti mai tagata uma, ona fai mai lea o Peteru ma i latou sa faatasi ma ia, Le Alii e, ua fetaomi ma fetuleni mai le motu o tagata ia te oe, e te fetalai mai ea, O ai na pa‘i mai ia te au?

verses.en: And Jesus said, Somebody hath touched me: for I perceive that virtue is gone out of me.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu Iesu, Na pa‘i mai lava se tasi ia te au; auā ua ou iloa ua alu atu le mana nai ia te au.

verses.en: And when the woman saw that she was not hid, she came trembling, and falling down before him, she declared unto him before all the people for what cause she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.
verses.sm: Ua iloa e le fafine ua le lilo o ia, ona alu atu lea o ia ma le gatete, ua faapaū mai i ona luma, ma faamatala mai ia te ia i luma o le nuu uma le mea na pa‘i atu ai o ia ia te ia, ma le faamaloloina loa o ia.

verses.en: And he said unto her, Daughter, be of good comfort: thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu lea o ia ia te ia, Lo‘u afafine e, ina faalototele ia oe; ua e ola i lou faatuatua; ina alu ia oe ma le manuia.

verses.en: While he yet spake, there cometh one from the ruler of the synagogue's house, saying to him, Thy daughter is dead; trouble not the Master.
verses.sm: Ua sau le tasi mai le fale o le pule i le sunako a o fetalai o ia, ua fai mai ia te ia. Ua oti lou afafine; soia e te faalavelaveina le a‘oa‘o.

verses.en: But when Jesus heard it, he answered him, saying, Fear not: believe only, and she shall be made whole.
verses.sm: Ua faafofoga i ai Iesu, ona tali atu lea o ia ia te ia, ua faapea atu, Aua e te fefe; tau ina e faatuatua, e ola ai o ia.

verses.en: And when he came into the house, he suffered no man to go in, save Peter, and James, and John, and the father and the mother of the maiden.
verses.sm: Ua ulu atu ia i le fale, e le mafai ia te ia ona ulu atu se tasi, tau o Peteru, ma Iakopo, ma Ioane, o le tamā foi ma le tinā o le teine.

verses.en: And all wept, and bewailed her: but he said, Weep not; she is not dead, but sleepeth.
verses.sm: Ua fetagisi i latou uma, ma tagitu‘i ona o ia; a ua fetalai atu ia, Soia le fetagisi; e lei oti o ia, a ua moe.

verses.en: And they laughed him to scorn, knowing that she was dead.
verses.sm: Ua latou tapisa ia te ia, auā ua latou iloa ua oti o ia.

verses.en: And he put them all out, and took her by the hand, and called, saying, Maid, arise.
verses.sm: A o ia, ua na tulia i latou uma i fafo, ona tago atu lea o ia i lona lima, ua valaau, ua faapea atu, Funa e, ina tulai ia.

verses.en: And her spirit came again, and she arose straightway: and he commanded to give her meat.
verses.sm: Ua toe foi mai lona agaga, ona tulai loa lea o ia; ua fetalai atu foi o ia, ia avatu ni ana mea e ‘ai.

verses.en: And her parents were astonished: but he charged them that they should tell no man what was done.
verses.sm: Ona matuā ofo ai lea o ona mātua; a ua vavao o ia ia te i laua, aua ne‘i tala atu i se tasi le mea ua faia.
